z-m-08-04.title: Amarekhodi okweqa phezulu: ngubani weqe phezulu kakhulu?
z-m-08-04.topic: Ukuqhathanisa inombolo enendawo eyodwa yedesimali nenombolo enezindawo ezintathu zedesimali
z-m-08-04.goal: Qhathanisa amadesimali ngenani lendawo esikhundleni sokuthi anamadijithi amangaki, uhlole isinqumo sakho njengoba kufika idatha entsha, bese wenza wena isibonelo esiphikisayo somthetho ongalungile.
z-m-08-04.material: Emjahweni wezemidlalo wesikole wokweqa phezulu, amarekhodi ka-Seoyun no-Dohyeon alinganiswe. Irekhodi liwukuphakama ngamamitha (m) kusukela phansi kuya ebhareni, kulinganiswe ngethephu. Amarekhodi anikezwa isinyathelo esisodwa ngesikhathi.
z-m-08-04.thinking.0: Ukuhlola isinqumo sakho njengoba idatha ingezwa
z-m-08-04.prereq.0: Ukufunda nokubhala amadesimali anendawo eyodwa, ezimbili nezintathu zedesimali
z-m-08-04.prereq.1: Ukwazi ukuthi u-1 m ungu-100 cm
z-m-08-04.s.s1.prompt: Bheka idatha iphuzu ngalinye, wahlulele ukuthi ngubani weqe phezulu, bese uhlola isinqumo sakho uma kufika idatha entsha.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.hint.0: Esinyathelweni ngasinye, hlulela usebenzisa kuphela lokho osukwazi kuze kube manje, futhi uqale ubhale ngamagama ukuthi isinqumo sakho siyashintsha yini uma kufika idatha entsha.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.hint.1: Shintsha amarekhodi amabili abe yiyunithi efanayo bese uwaqhathanisa eceleni komunye.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Irekhodi luka-Seoyun lingu-1.4 m futhi irekhodi luka-Dohyeon lingu-1.38 m.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ubheka amadijithi kuphela, ucabanga ini manje?
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Kokubili isinqumo sokuthi u-Seoyun uphezulu nesinqumo sokuthi kusesekuseni ukunquma kunengqondo kulesi sinyathelo. Ungakwazi ukunquma ngokuqala ngokuqhathanisa izindawo zamashumi.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Lesi kungaba yisinqumo esibheke izindawo zamashumi namakhulu.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: U-Dohyeon weqe phezulu kakhulu, ngoba 38 inkulu kuno-4
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ufunde amadijithi ngemva kwephoyinti ledesimali njengenombolo ephelele futhi waqhathanisa 38 no-4. Ngamadesimali, kumele uqale ubheke ukuthi idijithi ngayinye isendaweni ephi.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ukuvuma ngobuqotho ukuthi awuqinisekile futhi ulinde idatha elandelayo kunengqondo nakho.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Ithephu lokulinganisa linezimpawu ezinkulu ezihlukanisa ingxenye engaphezu kuka-1 m yaba izikhala eziyi-10, futhi uma isikhala ngasinye salezo sihlukaniswa futhi saba eziyi-10, kunezikhala ezingu-100 sekukonke. U-1.4 m ka-Seoyun uyizikhala ezingu-4 ngaphezu kuka-1 m ezimpawini ezinkulu. U-1.38 m ka-Dohyeon uyizikhala ezingu-38 ngaphezu kuka-1 m ezimpawini zezikhala ezingu-100.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Manje njengoba ubonile idatha yesikali, ucabanga ukuthi ngubani ophezulu?
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.1.after: U-1.4 m ufana no-1.40 m, ngakho uyizigaba ezingu-40. Noma enamadijithi ambalwa, inombolo ingaba nkulu ngenxa yenani lendawo.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Esikalini sezigaba ezingu-100, u-1.4 uyizigaba ezingu-40, ngakho ungaphezulu kwezigaba ezingu-38.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Hlola futhi esikalini ukuthi inombolo 38 incane kuno-40.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Zombili izirekhodi zisesikalini, ngakho ungakwazi ukunquma ngale datha.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.2.info: U-Harin naye weqe. Irekhodi luka-Harin lingu-1.405 m. Futhi u-1.4 m ka-Seoyun uphakama ngokufanayo noma ubhala u-1.40 m noma u-1.400 m.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Iyiphi eyaleka amarekhodi amathathu ngokulandelana kusukela phezulu kuya phansi?
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.2.after: U-1.405 uphezulu ngo-0.005 kunoku-1.400. Ngakho ukulandelana ngu-Harin, u-Seoyun, u-Dohyeon. Ukulandelana kuka-Seoyun no-Dohyeon akushintshanga lapho kufika idatha entsha.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Lokhu ukulandelana okutholwa ngokucabanga ukuthi onamadijithi amaningi mkhulu. Bhala u-1.4 njengo-1.400 bese uqhathanisa kusukela endaweni yamashumi.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: U-1.405 no-1.4 (= 1.400) bahluka okokuqala endaweni yezinkulungwane, futhi u-1.38 uhluka endaweni yamakhulu.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: U-Seoyun no-Harin bafana, no-Dohyeon uphansi kakhulu
z-m-08-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Washaya indiva u-5 ekugcineni ku-1.405. U-1.400 no-1.405 yizinombolo ezihlukile.
z-m-08-04.s.s1.reflect: Noma kwafika idatha entsha, isinqumo sokuthi u-Seoyun weqe phezulu kuno-Dohyeon sahlala sinjalo. Okushintshile ukulandelana ngemva kokungezwa kuka-Harin. Amadesimali aqhathaniswa ngenani lendawo yedijithi ngayinye, hhayi ngokuthi anamadijithi amangaki.
z-m-08-04.s.s2.prompt: Umngani uthi, "Inombolo enamadijithi amaningi ngemva kwephoyinti ledesimali iyinombolo enkulu." Usebenzisa amadesimali amabili amasha ngaphandle kuka-1.4, 1.38, no-1.405 owabona ngenhla, bonisa ukuthi lesi sitatimende asilungile futhi ubhale ukuthi iyiphi enkulu.
z-m-08-04.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ngamadesimali amabili anamadijithi ahlukile endaweni yamashumi.
z-m-08-04.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala inombolo enkulu kuze kufike endaweni yamaphesenti (ngokuncamathisela u-0) futhi uqhathanise izinombolo ezimbili eceleni komunye.
z-m-08-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Emadesimali amabili owanikezile, lelo elinamadijithi amaningi liyinombolo encane yini?
z-m-08-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ucabange ngeqiniso lokuthi ubude obufanayo bungabhalwa ngenani elihlukile lamadijithi ngemva kwephoyinti ledesimali (1.4 = 1.40)?
z-m-08-04.s.s2.model.0: Bheka u-0.5 no-0.45. U-0.45 unamadijithi amaningi, kodwa u-0.5 ungu-0.50, ngakho mkhulu kuno-0.45.
z-m-08-04.s.s2.model.1: Kukhona u-2.3 no-2.27. U-2.27 unamadijithi amaningi, kodwa u-2.3 ungu-2.30, ngakho u-2.3 mkhulu.
z-m-08-04.s.s2.model.2: Bheka u-0.9 no-0.89. U-0.89 unamadijithi amabili ngemva kwephoyinti ledesimali, kodwa u-0.9=0.90, ngakho u-0.9 mkhulu.

z-m-08-07.title: Inombolo eyenziwa amakhadi amabili inamadijithi amangaki?
z-m-08-07.goal: Hlola isimangalo esijwayelekile ngezibonelo eziphikisayo, linganisela amacala amancane nakhulu kakhulu, futhi usho ibanga lemiphumela engenzeka kanye nemibandela.
z-m-08-07.material: Ake senze imikhiqizo ngamakhadi ezinombolo. Dweba ikhadi elilodwa elinenombolo yamadijithi amathathu (100 kuya ku-999) nekhadi elilodwa elinenombolo yamadijithi amabili (10 kuya ku-99), futhi uphindaphinde izinombolo ezimbili. UMinseo wathi, "Uma uphindaphinda inombolo yamadijithi amathathu ngenombolo yamadijithi amabili, uthola njalo inombolo yamadijithi amahlanu. Ngoba 3 + 2 = 5!"
z-m-08-07.prereq.0: Ukuphindaphinda inombolo yamadijithi amathathu ngenombolo yamadijithi amabili ngokulinganisela noma ngokubala (izinga leBanga 4)
z-m-08-07.s.s1.prompt: Khetha onke amapheya amakhadi angasetshenziswa ukukhombisa ukuthi isitatimende sikaMinseo asilungile. Ngaphambi kokubala, qala ucabange ngokulinganisela.
z-m-08-07.s.s1.hint.0: Kupheya ngalinye, shintsha izinombolo ezimbili zibe ngamakhulu noma amashumi aseduze futhi ulinganisele usayizi womkhiqizo.
z-m-08-07.s.s1.hint.1: Hlela okukhethwayo ngokuthi umkhiqizo mncane noma mkhulu kuno-10000 (izinkulungwane eziyishumi).
z-m-08-07.s.s1.r.a: Linganisela ngokungaqondile ukuthi umkhiqizo wezinombolo ezimbili ezinkulu kakhulu uyini. Lo mkhiqizo unamadijithi amangaki?
z-m-08-07.s.s1.r.c: Sebenza ukuthi u-500 × 40 useqinini noma emashumini ezinkulungwane. Ingabe lepheya ingaphazamisa isitatimende sikaMinseo?
z-m-08-07.s.s1.r.d: Lona ngumkhiqizo wamakhadi amabili amancane kakhulu.
z-m-08-07.s.s1.r.e: Linganisela ukuthi u-120 × 50 useqinini noma emashumini ezinkulungwane.
z-m-08-07.s.s1.explain: Ukuphazamisa isitatimende sikaMinseo, udinga ipheya enomkhiqizo oyinombolo yamadijithi amane. 345 × 27 = 9315, 100 × 10 = 1000, no-120 × 50 = 6000 zonke zinombolo zamadijithi amane. 999 × 99 = 98901 no-500 × 40 = 20000 zinombolo zamadijithi amahlanu, ngakho aziphikisani nesitatimende sikaMinseo.
z-m-08-07.s.s2.prompt: Hlola isitatimende sikaMinseo. Khetha inombolo yamadijithi amathathu a nenombolo yamadijithi amabili b ukwenza ipheya eyodwa enomkhiqizo oyinombolo yamadijithi amane nepheya eyodwa enomkhiqizo oyinombolo yamadijithi amahlanu. (Amapheya amabili kumele abe nemikhiqizo enamanani ahlukene amadijithi.)
z-m-08-07.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ezinombolweni ezincane futhi uqale ubale ukuthi umkhiqizo unamadijithi amangaki ezinombolweni ezifana no-100 no-10.
z-m-08-07.s.s2.hint.1: Linganisela ukuthi yimuphi phakathi kuka-a no-b okumele wenze ube mkhulu, nokuthi ngokungakanani, ukuze umkhiqizo udlule u-10000.
z-m-08-07.s.s2.fail.c2: U-a kumele abe yinombolo yamadijithi amathathu kusukela ku-100 kuya ku-999.
z-m-08-07.s.s2.fail.c3: U-b kumele abe yinombolo yamadijithi amabili kusukela ku-10 kuya ku-99.
z-m-08-07.s.s2.explain: Isibonelo, 345 × 27 = 9315 yinombolo yamadijithi amane futhi 500 × 40 = 20000 yinombolo yamadijithi amahlanu. 100 × 10 = 1000 no-120 × 50 = 6000 zinombolo zamadijithi amane, futhi 999 × 99 = 98901 no-250 × 60 = 15000 zinombolo zamadijithi amahlanu. Kubalwa kuphela uma imikhiqizo emibili inamanani ahlukene amadijithi.
z-m-08-07.s.s3.prompt: Ungasho ini ngokuthi umkhiqizo wenombolo yamadijithi amathathu nenombolo yamadijithi amabili unamadijithi amangaki? Bhala isizathu sakho ngokulinganisela noma ngokubala icala elincane kakhulu nelikhulu kakhulu.
z-m-08-07.s.s3.hint.0: Phindaphinda inombolo encane kakhulu yamadijithi amathathu ngenombolo encane kakhulu yamadijithi amabili.
z-m-08-07.s.s3.hint.1: Linganisela umkhiqizo wezinombolo ezimbili ezinkulu kakhulu ngokuqhathanisa no-100 × 100.
z-m-08-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uthole ukuthi umkhiqizo omncane kakhulu (100 × 10) nomkhiqizo omkhulu kakhulu (999 × 99) ngamunye unamadijithi amangaki?
z-m-08-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ucabange ukuthi ungazi kanjani ukuthi yonke imikhiqizo ephakathi inamadijithi amane noma amahlanu?
z-m-08-07.s.s3.model.0: Iyinombolo yamadijithi amane noma yamadijithi amahlanu. Omncane kakhulu, 100 × 10 = 1000, uyinombolo yamadijithi amane, futhi omkhulu kakhulu, 999 × 99, mncane kuno-100000 (izinkulungwane eziyikhulu), ngakho awuphenduki inombolo yamadijithi ayisithupha. Phakathi, kuba namadijithi amahlanu uma sekudlula u-10000.
z-m-08-07.s.s3.model.1: Umkhiqizo ungaba namadijithi angu-4 noma amadijithi angu-5. 345 × 27 = 9315 unamadijithi amane, futhi 500 × 40 = 20000 unamadijithi amahlanu. Awukwazi ukuba mncane kuno-1000 futhi awukwazi ukudlula izinkulungwane eziyikhulu.
z-m-08-07.s.s3.model.2: Umkhiqizo uyinombolo yamadijithi amane noma yamadijithi amahlanu. Omncane kakhulu, 100×10=1000, unamadijithi amane, futhi omkhulu kakhulu, 999×99, mncane kuno-100000, ngakho unamadijithi amahlanu ngokuphelele.

z-m-08-02.title: Amakhadi amabili ahlangana abe ngu-90: izikolo nazo zizofana?
z-m-08-02.topic: Ukuqhathanisa usayizi bemiphumela yezinombolo ezimbili zamadijithi amabili
z-m-08-02.goal: Qonda ukuthi isibonelo esisodwa asikwazi ukuqinisekisa "njalo kufana", yenza izibonelo ezihlukile ezihlangabezana nesimo, uziqhathanise, bese ucacisa ukuthi amapheya anezikolo ezinkulu abelana ngani.
z-m-08-02.material: Ake sidlale umdlalo wamakhadi ezinombolo. Ikhadi ngalinye linenombolo eyodwa yemvelo ebhalwe kusukela ku-10 kuya ku-99. Umthetho: ukhetha amakhadi amabili, futhi izinombolo ezimbili kumele zihlangane zibe ngu-90 ncamashi. Isikolo siyizinombolo ezimbili eziphindaphindiwe. U-Sua ukhethe u-40 no-50 futhi wathola amaphuzu angu-2000. Wabe esethi, "Uma isamba singu-90, isikolo sihlala singamaphuzu angu-2000!" Ukulandelana obeka ngakho amakhadi akubalulekile. (30 no-60, kanye no-60 no-30, kuyipheya elifanayo.)
z-m-08-02.thinking.0: Ukuhlukanisa lokho isibonelo esisodwa esikutshela kona nalokho esingakutsheli kona
z-m-08-02.prereq.0: Ukuphindaphinda izinombolo zamadijithi amabili ngazinye (izinga leBanga 4, ngaphandle kwekhalkhulethara)
z-m-08-02.prereq.1: Ukubhanqa izinombolo zemvelo ukuze zibe nesamba esifanayo
z-m-08-02.s.s1.prompt: U-Sua ukhulume ngemva kokubona umphumela wepheya elilodwa u-40 no-50. Umphumela walelo pheya elilodwa usitshela ini ngesitatimende sika-Sua?
z-m-08-02.s.s1.hint.0: Isitatimende sika-Sua sinegama elithi "njalo". Cabanga ngesinyathelo esishesha kakhulu sokuthola ukuthi leso sitatimende siyiqiniso yini.
z-m-08-02.s.s1.hint.1: Yenza noma yiliphi elinye ipheya elinesamba esingu-90 bese uthola isikolo salo.
z-m-08-02.s.s1.o.a: U-40 no-50 banikeze amaphuzu angu-2000, ngakho noma yiliphi ipheya linikeza amaphuzu angu-2000
z-m-08-02.s.s1.r.a: Isibonelo esisodwa esilungile asiqinisekisi "njalo". Kuthiwani uma uhlola namanye amapheya?
z-m-08-02.s.s1.o.b: Akunakunqunywa kuze kuhlolwe elinye ipheya elinesamba esingu-90
z-m-08-02.s.s1.r.b: Ukhombile ukuthi isibonelo esisodwa asikwazi ukusitshela "njalo".
z-m-08-02.s.s1.o.c: Singanquma manje ukuthi izikolo azifani noma amasamba efana
z-m-08-02.s.s1.r.c: Umphumela wepheya elilodwa wodwa awukwazi ukuqinisekisa "akufani". Kumele wenze ngempela amanye amapheya bese uqhathanisa.
z-m-08-02.s.s1.o.d: Asikazi okwamanje. Ngakho asidingi ukuhlola elinye ipheya
z-m-08-02.s.s1.r.d: Ulungile ukuzwa ukuthi awazi, kodwa uma ungazi, ukuhlola kuyisinyathelo esilandelayo.
z-m-08-02.s.s1.explain: U-40 no-50 banikeza amaphuzu angu-2000 kuyisibonelo nje esingaphikisani nesitatimende sika-Sua. Ukuze wazi ukuthi "uma isamba singu-90, isikolo sihlala sifana" siyiqiniso yini, kumele uhlole amanye amapheya anesamba esingu-90. Uma elinye ipheya linikeza isikolo esihlukile, leli pheya liyisibonelo esiphikisayo.
z-m-08-02.s.s2.prompt: Yenza amapheya amathathu amakhadi amadijithi amabili anesamba esingu-90 anezikolo ezihlukile. (Ukushintshanisa amakhadi amabili kunikeza ipheya elifanayo.)
z-m-08-02.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha ikhadi lokuqala, bese ukhipha leyo nombolo ku-90 ukwenza ikhadi lesibili.
z-m-08-02.s.s2.hint.1: Shintsha ikhadi lokuqala, weqe kusukela ku-10 kuya ku-90, kodwa uhlole ukuthi zombili izinombolo ziyizinombolo zamadijithi amabili.
z-m-08-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Amakhadi anezinombolo zemvelo kuphela ezibhalwe kuwo.
z-m-08-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Izinombolo ezikumakhadi ziyizinombolo zamadijithi amabili kusukela ku-10 kuya ku-99.
z-m-08-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Isamba sezinombolo ezimbili asingu-90. Zengeze ukuhlola.
z-m-08-02.s.s2.explain: Amapheya anesamba esingu-90 anezikolo ezihlukile, njengo-(40, 50) = amaphuzu angu-2000, (30, 60) = amaphuzu angu-1800, (20, 70) = amaphuzu angu-1400, (45, 45) = amaphuzu angu-2025, no-(11, 79) = amaphuzu angu-869. Njengoba amanye amapheya enesamba esifanayo kodwa imiphumela ehlukile, isitatimende sika-Sua asilungile njalo. Ipheya eliguqulwe (50 no-40) liyipheya elifanayo, ngakho libale njengelilodwa kuphela.
z-m-08-02.s.s3.prompt: Qhathanisa izikolo zamapheya owenzile. Izinombolo ezimbili zazibukeka kanjani epheyeni elinesikolo esikhulu kakhulu? Chaza indlela eyodwa yokukhetha amakhadi ukuze isikolo sibe sikhulu. Sebenzisa amapheya owathola ngempela njengezibonelo.
z-m-08-02.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala izikolo zamapheya owenzile ngokulandelana kusukela kokukhulu kakhulu kuya kokuncane kakhulu, futhi ubhale nomehluko phakathi kwezinombolo ezimbili epheyeni ngalinye.
z-m-08-02.s.s3.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi izinombolo ezimbili zihlukene kangakanani emapheyeni anezikolo ezinkulu nasemapheyeni anezikolo ezincane.
z-m-08-02.s.s3.placeholder: isb., Ipheya elinesikolo esikhulu kakhulu bekungu-...
z-m-08-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uphindaphinde ngempela ukuthola izikolo zezibonelo zakho?
z-m-08-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ungahlola futhi ukuthi ipheya elisha elikhethwe ngendlela oyichazile lithola ngempela isikolo esikhulu?
z-m-08-02.s.s3.model.0: U-40 no-50 banikeze amaphuzu angu-2000, u-30 no-60 banikeze amaphuzu angu-1800, no-20 no-70 banikeze amaphuzu angu-1400. Uma izinombolo ezimbili zisondelene kakhulu, isikolo sibe sikhulu. Ngakho uma ngikhetha izinombolo ezinomehluko omncane njengo-45 no-45, ngicabanga ukuthi kuzoba kukhulu nakakhulu.
z-m-08-02.s.s3.model.1: Uma umehluko epheyeni mncane, isikolo sikhulu. Umehluko phakathi kuka-40 no-50 ungu-10 futhi isikolo singu-2000, kodwa u-20 no-70 banomehluko ongu-50 futhi banikeza u-1400. Uma isamba singu-90, kuhle ukukhetha izinombolo eziseduze no-45.

z-m-08-06.title: Uma uhlanganisa amaribhoni amabili, azokwenza u-4 m?
z-m-08-06.topic: Ukwengeza izinombolo ezinamadesimali amabili nezeyunithi zobude
z-m-08-06.goal: Hlulela ukuthi ungafinyelela esiphethweni ngolwazi olunikeziwe yini, sho ukuthi yini enye odinga ukuyazi, futhi ubonise ngezinombolo ukuthi isiphetho siyashintsha kanjani kuye ngemibandela.
z-m-08-06.material: Ukubopha kanye ngokuphelele ebhokisini, udinga intambo okungenani engu-4 m (eyanele ngqo). Unamaribhoni amabili: ribhoni obomvu elingu-2.4 m neribhoni oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka elingu-1.65 m. Ufuna ukuhlanganisa amaribhoni amabili abe elilodwa.
